title: The rigid, pre-arranged Wilbur DeParis band
summary: DeParis's routines never changed but he kept the band on its toes, which Cheatham liked.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: How free was that band? The Wilbur DeParis band? It seemed to -- it always seemed to me that it was fairly sort of rigid and pre-arranged.
I was -- it was rigid and pre-arranged. Everything was the same, every night. Routines were the same.

But he kept the band on its toes. He wouldn't let you let down one minute. And I liked that. I liked -- I don't want to get to the place where somebody says come on, come on, come on. I don't like that. And maybe that
helped -- answers your question. I practice everyday.
